'''Virtual Set 22''' is a Players Committee virtual expansion from the 2014 Reset onward. It was released 2 October 2023. These are not Decipher cards.

Current virtual cards are maintained by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee. Printable slips are published with each set.

During your control phase, if you occupy two battleground marker sites, retrieve 1 Force. Flip this card if opponent occupies your Hoth location.
|-
| [[File:V22-L-prepareforgroundassault.gif|200px|link=The Empire Knows We're Here / Prepare For Ground Assault]] || [[The Empire Knows We're Here / Prepare For Ground Assault|The Empire Knows We're Here/Prepare For Ground Assault]] || [[Objective|Objective]] || U || 7 || While this side up, cancels Hoth Sentry, Sunsdown, and the game text of your Admiral's Orders and unique (•) characters (except gunners, pilots, and troopers on table). Cards 'hit' by your artillery or vehicle weapons may not be used to satisfy attrition. If you just initiated battle, may peek at top X cards of your Used Pile, where X = number of Hoth battlegrounds you occupy; take one into hand and shuffle your Used Pile. Flip this card if opponent does not occupy your Hoth location.
